plan.title: Stock plan
plan.no_floor: The plan shows where every item is kept, floor by floor. It is drawn in three steps:
plan.group_hint: Drag any of them to move the whole group, or use the arrows and R on the keyboard.
plan.group_changed: A rectangle of the group was changed in the meantime: nothing was changed. The plan has been read again; make the move again.
plan.nothing_drawn: No location is drawn on this floor yet.
plan.plan_of: Plan of {{floor}}: {{count}} {count, plural, one {rectangle} other {rectangles}} drawn
plan.trace_hint: Drag on the plan to trace the footprint, then choose the location.
plan.pose_rule: Choose a shape: it is placed in the middle of the plan, selected. Drag it or type its measurements, then Save.
plan.level_hint: The ground floor is 0; a storey above it is a larger number, up to 200.
plan.location_hint: A location is in one place, so it is drawn once. Bins are not offered.
plan.footprint_hint: In metres from the floor’s top-left corner, snapped to the quarter-metre.
plan.rotation_hint: In steps of 15°, for a rack set against a wall at an angle.
plan.structure_note: Nothing here is a stock location: a wall holds no goods and appears on no list.
plan.structure_hint: What this piece draws. A door and a dock are cut into a wall: their thickness is the wall's.
plan.structure_name_hint: The name the store already uses, if it has one.
plan.layer_locked: Lock this layer so the pointer no longer catches it
plan.repeat_spacing_hint: The free floor between two rectangles. Zero puts them back to back.
plan.repeat_off_floor: A copy would leave the floor. Change the direction, the spacing or the count.
plan.repeat_incomplete: Give a count, a spacing and a code ending in a number.
plan.views: Ways to look at the floor

view_coming.facade: A rack’s front, its columns and levels, is coming soon.

plan.floor_meta: Level {{level}} · {{count}} {count, plural, one {location drawn} other {locations drawn}}
plan.arrange_hint: Drag a shape to move it, its handles to resize it; nothing is saved until Save.
plan.read_note: Reading: touching the plan moves nothing
plan.press_hint: Press a place to see what it holds.
plan.keys_hint: Wheel or + / − to come nearer, arrows to move around
plan.board: Floor plan. + and − to come nearer, arrows to move around.
plan.panel_hint_read: Touch a rectangle on the plan, or pick it in the list, to see what it holds.
plan.panel_hint_arrange: Pick a shape to place: it lands in the middle, selected. Drag it or type its measurements, then Save.

here.title: What is here
here.nothing: Nothing is stored here, according to the recorded movements.
here.more: {{count}} more {count, plural, one {line} other {lines}}: see them all in Stock
here.empty_home: {{product}} has its place here ({{place}}) and none is left: empty, to be refilled.
here.truth: What this says comes from the recorded movements: goods received into a place under this one count here.

search.label: Find a product
search.hint: Reference, name or barcode, or scan
search.nowhere: No stock is recorded for this product.
search.places_here: {{count}} {count, plural, one {place} other {places}} on this floor
search.note_nowhere: {{count}} {count, plural, one {line} other {lines}} not found on the plan
search.line_nowhere: No stock is recorded for this product.
search.nowhere_drawn: This item is in no drawn place.

volume.note: The 3D is for looking only. To change anything, go back to the 2D plan.
volume.keys_hint: Drag to turn, wheel to come nearer, Shift and drag to move
volume.summary: {{floor}}: {{racks}} {racks, plural, one {rack} other {racks}}, {{zones}} {zones, plural, one {zone} other {zones}}
volume.missing: This browser cannot show the 3D (WebGL 2 is not available here). The 2D plan shows the same floor.
volume.failed: The 3D view could not be loaded. The 2D plan shows the same floor.
volume.read_only: The 3D is looked at in View; in Arrange, the plan is 2D.

first.title: Draw your depot
first.wider: The plan is drawn on a wider screen. Here it is read, searched and scanned.
first.ask: The first floor is drawn by someone who may arrange the stock.

steps.measure: Measure the floor, its width and its depth
steps.build: Put up the walls, doors and posts (optional)
steps.place: Place your racks and zones, each on its stock location

plan.new_location_hint: Proposed after the last of this kind; it is placed in the zone it is drawn in.

move.pick_hint: Touch the destination place on the plan, or choose it in « To location ».
move.undo_failed: The move of {{product}} could not be undone: what was moved is no longer where it was put.
